facts.fact: 母亲的空手作桌旗与Georgia 需求对接：她答应把店里的红玫瑰桌旗借给 Georgia（不只是帮工，而是供货）。

facts.anchor: “What on earth made Georgia want to open a store like this?” Mom asked with a note of disdain as she wandered, purse hugged tightly under her arm.
facts.fact: 母亲与 Meg 的分工落地：她负责把 Georgia 的橱窗主题做出来（spring makeover），Meg 负责把店里卖好——这对母女第一次像合伙人。
